description: Same as lex_get_document, for a eur-lex.europa.eu URL the user pasted (the CELEX is extracted from CELEX:… or uri=…). Always English. For ELI/ECLI links use lex_resolve first. Cost: 1 / 4 / 5 credits by source.

bypassCorpus.description: Force a fresh upstream read (live rate).

include.description: Only these parts. "paragraphs" = judgment grounds / text of documents without articles.

offset.description: Continue after a truncated response (value given in its note).

url.description: A eur-lex.europa.eu URL containing CELEX:<id> or uri=CELEX:<id>.

view.description: auto: the body if it fits maxChars, else an outline. full: body up to maxChars, then offset to continue.

name: lex_get_document_by_url
title: Fetch an EU document by EUR-Lex URL
